purpose: DocQuorum configuration frozen BEFORE any held-out benchmark was downloaded or inspected. A held-out run may change only input/output adapters, never the pipeline.
reorganised_2026_09_29: The code was reorganised into docquorum/tools, agents and checks without changing any result: identical check outputs on 730 stored readings; identical requests and readings for every reader-agent run (short, medium and long splits; text and parse), the column-flow and ruled readers and the UNIKIE readings under a recording client (with Python's hash seed fixed); identical quorum picks and scores. One intended difference: a schema split into parts now lists its $defs in the schema's own order; the old code listed them in Python's set order, which changed from run to run. The files the hashes below refer to are in results/archive/code_before_refactor_2026-09-29.tar.gz; the frozen versions of the four modules changed later are in results/archive/frozen_code_2026-09-28/. Every switch below is now a constant at the value listed; docs/CODE_GUIDE.md maps old names to new.
model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 served by vLLM 0.27.1 as 'qwen3vl' (GPU_UTIL 0.74, MAX_LEN 131072, 12 images x 1700x1700 profile); MinerU2.5-2509-1.2B parser
rule: text layer -> one agentic reading; no text layer -> parse reading (+ image and one-shot readings and the quorum when <= 12 pages); layout readers where the page geometry selects them; repairs + page checks on every reading
after_heldout: Four files were changed after the held-out UNIKIE-BENCH run: tool output decoded leniently, a long text document whose schema has no top-level list read in windows of its text, lists of plain values read as one-field records, and schema-valid output. They change no reported ExtractBench or UNIKIE-BENCH number (checked for every document). Their frozen versions are kept byte-identical in results/archive/frozen_code_2026-09-28/.
